title: VPN / Service Operations
description: Operational overview: server health, authenticated demand, capacity and workload diagnostics. User-path latency and reachability are not instrumented. Seven days of Prometheus retention.

options.content:
**One VPS · two VPN transports · 30 s collection · 7 d retention**

Server-side health and traffic are measured. **Client reachability, latency and request error rate are not instrumented**; green server checks cannot rule out ISP blocking. [Triage guide](https://github.com/sidosera/hm-gitops#operating-the-dashboard)

panels.title: Xray control API
panels.description: Native StatsService responsiveness, gated by the Xray exporter scrape. Confirms server control-plane health only. If failed, inspect proxy and exporter logs. Missing series stays UNKNOWN.

panels.title: Proxy pod readiness
panels.description: Current proxy pods must all be Ready. A failed kube-state-metrics scrape produces UNKNOWN. Readiness is not a VPN transaction.

panels.title: Telemetry coverage
panels.description: Exactly five expected scrape targets must exist and all must be up. Check the collector row before trusting traffic or resource values.

panels.title: Client IPs · lower bound
panels.description: Distinct authenticated source IPs across both transports. Shared NAT and ingress masking merge devices. Hidden if polling fails, textfile is older than 60 s, or node scraping fails. Not a device count.

targets.expr: xray_active_client_ips{job="node"} and on(instance) ((xray_online_scrape_success{job="node"} == 1) and on(instance) (up{job="node"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{job="node",file="/textfile/xray_online.prom"}) < 60))

panels.title: Memory headroom
panels.description: MemAvailable / MemTotal. Includes reclaimable cache; low free RAM alone is not a fault. <20% investigate, <10% urgent. Correlate with memory pressure and container limits.

panels.title: Root disk available
panels.description: Space available to unprivileged processes on /. <20% investigate, <10% urgent. Thresholds are triage hints, not an SLO.

panels.title: Client download by transport
panels.description: Authenticated inbound traffic. reality-legacy is the current primary; reality is the parallel listener; https-backup is the HTTPS fallback. Zero throughput may mean idle clients. Gaps are not bridged.

panels.title: Client upload by transport
panels.description: Authenticated inbound traffic. reality-legacy is the current primary; reality is the parallel listener; https-backup is the HTTPS fallback. Zero throughput may mean idle clients. Gaps are not bridged.

panels.title: Authenticated client IPs
panels.description: Lower-bound estimates of concurrent source IPs. Profile counts overlap and must not be added. Successful polling and a fresh textfile are required.

targets.expr: xray_active_client_ips{job="node"} and on(instance) ((xray_online_scrape_success{job="node"} == 1) and on(instance) (up{job="node"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{job="node",file="/textfile/xray_online.prom"}) < 60))

xray_active_profile_clients{job="node"} and on(instance) ((xray_online_scrape_success{job="node"} == 1) and on(instance) (up{job="node"} == 1) and on(instance) ((time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{job="node",file="/textfile/xray_online.prom"}) < 60))

panels.title: Transfer in selected window
panels.description: Estimated transferred bytes within the selected dashboard time window. Prometheus increase handles counter resets and extrapolates sample boundaries.

panels.title: CPU utilization by mode
panels.description: Average across CPU cores. Steal indicates hypervisor contention; iowait is time waiting for I/O, not CPU compute. Use PSI below to confirm waiting work.

panels.title: Memory availability & swap residency
panels.description: MemAvailable accounts for reclaimable memory. Occupied swap can remain after past pressure; use memory PSI and swap activity to identify current contention.

panels.title: Root filesystem headroom
panels.description: Data blocks and inodes can run out independently. Filesystem shares disk with Grafana, Prometheus and the archived dashboard. Both lines should stay above 20%.

panels.title: Pressure stalls · waiting work
panels.description: Linux PSI: percentage of elapsed time with at least one task stalled on a resource. Sustained memory or I/O pressure can explain slow service even when CPU is low. Collection begins with this dashboard rollout.

panels.title: Host network · physical interfaces
panels.description: Physical interface traffic includes all host services and transport overhead. It will differ from authenticated Xray payload rates.

panels.title: Swap activity
panels.description: Pages per second. Sustained swapping plus memory or I/O pressure is actionable. Nonzero swap residency by itself is not.

panels.title: Container memory / configured limit
panels.description: Working set / individual container memory limit. Unbounded containers are omitted. High values risk a container OOM even when host headroom is healthy. These are container limits, not pod-level effective limits.

panels.title: CPU by pod
panels.description: CPU seconds per second, in CPU cores. Host has two virtual CPUs. Workload selector changes only this diagnostics section.

panels.title: Current pod readiness
panels.description: Ready state of active pods. Completed and failed jobs are excluded. UNKNOWN indicates missing telemetry. Inspect Kubernetes events if a pod stays NOT READY.

panels.title: Restarts · rolling 15 minutes
panels.description: Recent restarts, not lifetime totals. A pod replacement changes its identity and is not counted as a restart. Inspect last termination reason and events for the cause.

panels.title: Collector availability
panels.description: Successful scrapes only; this is monitoring availability, not user-facing VPN availability. Missing history stays blank.

panels.title: Collector age & scrape duration
panels.description: The online-client file should be updated every 15 s. At 60 s the client panels stop showing counts. Scrapes time out at 8 s; a longer file age can mean the poller stopped.

panels.title: Network errors & dropped packets
panels.description: Host interface counters, not proxy request errors. ISP blocking may leave these at zero.

panels.title: Memory used by monitoring
panels.description: Monitoring overhead relative to host memory use. Working set and MemAvailable are different accounting views and are not additive.

options.content:
**Clients cannot connect, server checks green** → test the existing profile from the affected mobile/Wi-Fi network. This dashboard does not observe ISP/DPI blocking, transaction latency, TLS handshakes or request failures. No end-to-end SLO or error budget is calculated.

**Xray API failed / proxy not ready** → inspect proxy pod logs and Kubernetes events. API failure can also be an exporter-to-Xray connection failure.

**Clients UNKNOWN** → check node scraping, online-client file age and the poller logs. Zero means a successful fresh observation with no active source IPs.

**Low memory / restarts** → compare container-limit utilization with host PSI and swap activity. **Disk low** → inspect space and inode use before removing data.

Threshold colors are investigation guides, not paging alerts. Seven days of retention starts at Prometheus installation; gaps remain gaps.
